maddeler.e:
ارتأيت (form VIII)
# اِرْتَأَيْتُ (irtaʔaytu) /ir.ta.ʔaj.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
# اِرْتَأَيْتَ (irtaʔayta) /ir.ta.ʔaj.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
# اِرْتَأَيْتِ (irtaʔayti) /ir.ta.ʔaj.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِرْتَأَى (irtaʔā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
